description: Defines the QuicUnackedPacketMap class for tracking unacknowledged packets in QUIC protocol, including packet retransmission, congestion control, and RTT measurement.

classes.name: QuicUnackedPacketMap
classes.description: Manages unacknowledged packets for QUIC, handling retransmissions, congestion control, and RTT measurements.

methods.name: AddSentPacket
methods.description: Adds a sent packet to the map, marking it as in flight if specified.

methods.name: IsUnacked
methods.description: Checks if a packet is unacknowledged.

methods.name: NotifyFramesAcked
methods.description: Notifies that frames have been acknowledged.

methods.name: NotifyFramesLost
methods.description: Notifies that frames are considered lost.

methods.name: RetransmitFrames
methods.description: Requests retransmission of specified frames.

methods.name: RemoveFromInFlight
methods.description: Marks a packet or transmission as no longer in flight.

methods.name: NeuterUnencryptedPackets
methods.description: Neuters all unencrypted packets to prevent retransmission.

methods.name: NeuterHandshakePackets
methods.description: Neuters handshake packets to prevent retransmission.

methods.name: HasRetransmittableFrames
methods.description: Checks if a packet or transmission has retransmittable frames.

methods.name: HasUnackedRetransmittableFrames
methods.description: Checks if there are any unacknowledged retransmittable frames.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the map has no unacknowledged packets.

methods.name: largest_sent_packet
methods.description: Returns the largest packet number sent.

methods.name: largest_sent_largest_acked
methods.description: Returns the largest sent largest acknowledged.

methods.name: largest_acked
methods.description: Returns the largest acknowledged packet number.

methods.name: bytes_in_flight
methods.description: Returns total bytes in flight.

methods.name: packets_in_flight
methods.description: Returns total packets in flight.

methods.name: GetLeastUnacked
methods.description: Returns the smallest unacknowledged packet number.

methods.name: HasInFlightPackets
methods.description: Checks if there are packets currently in flight.

methods.name: GetTransmissionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves transmission info for a specific packet.

methods.name: GetMutableTransmissionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves mutable transmission info for a specific packet.

methods.name: GetLastInFlightPacketSentTime
methods.description: Returns the send time of the last in-flight packet.

methods.name: GetLastCryptoPacketSentTime
methods.description: Returns the send time of the last crypto packet.

methods.name: GetNumUnackedPacketsDebugOnly
methods.description: Returns the number of unacknowledged packets (debug).

methods.name: HasMultipleInFlightPackets
methods.description: Checks if multiple packets are in flight.

methods.name: HasPendingCryptoPackets
methods.description: Checks if there are pending crypto packets.

methods.name: HasUnackedStreamData
methods.description: Checks if there is unacknowledged stream data.

methods.name: RemoveRetransmittability
methods.description: Removes retransmittability from a transmission.

methods.name: IncreaseLargestAcked
methods.description: Increases the largest acknowledged packet number.

methods.name: MaybeUpdateLargestAckedOfPacketNumberSpace
methods.description: Updates the largest acknowledged packet number for a space.

methods.name: RemoveObsoletePackets
methods.description: Removes obsolete packets.

methods.name: MaybeAggregateAckedStreamFrame
methods.description: Attempts to aggregate acknowledged stream frames.

methods.name: NotifyAggregatedStreamFrameAcked
methods.description: Notifies that aggregated stream data was acknowledged.

methods.name: GetPacketNumberSpace
methods.description: Returns the packet number space for a packet.

methods.name: GetLargestAckedOfPacketNumberSpace
methods.description: Returns the largest acknowledged packet in a space.

methods.name: GetLargestSentRetransmittableOfPacketNumberSpace
methods.description: Returns the largest sent retransmittable packet in a space.

methods.name: GetLargestSentPacketOfPacketNumberSpace
methods.description: Returns the largest sent packet in a space.

methods.name: GetLastInFlightPacketSentTime
methods.description: Returns the send time of the last in-flight packet in a space.

methods.name: GetFirstInFlightTransmissionInfo
methods.description: Returns info of the first in-flight packet.

methods.name: GetFirstInFlightTransmissionInfoOfSpace
methods.description: Returns info of the first in-flight packet in a space.

methods.name: SetSessionNotifier
methods.description: Sets the session notifier interface.

methods.name: EnableMultiplePacketNumberSpacesSupport
methods.description: Enables support for multiple packet number spaces.

methods.name: GetLastPacketContent
methods.description: Returns a bitfield of retransmittable frame types in the last packet.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object state.
